content.text: Good afternoon, sir.

content.text: May I please see your passport and reservation?

content.text: Here you go.

content.text: Oh, I'm sorry, sir.

content.text: This flight has been canceled due to some mechanical problems.
content.trans: 这个飞行因为一些机械问题被取消了。

content.text: Canceled?
content.trans: 英语：取消了？

content.text: What am I supposed to do now?

content.text: We apologize for any inconveniences that may be caused by this.
content.trans: 我们向您道歉，因为可能给您带来不便。

content.text: If your flight is urgent, I could put you on a waiting list for another flight this

content.text: evening, but it's on a first-come, first-served basis.

content.text: So there's no guarantee you'll be able to take that flight.

content.text: What are my other options?
content.trans: 英语：什么是我其他的选择？

content.text: Well, if you can wait until tomorrow, we will put you up in a hotel for today, and you
content.trans: 嗯，如果明天你愿意等待，我们就把今天安排在酒店里，让你住上一天。

content.text: can take the scheduled flight for tomorrow morning.

content.text: That's fine.

content.text: I'll do that then.

content.text: Thank you for your understanding, sir.

content.text: I'll book your flight now.

content.text: Alright, we're back.

content.text: So we're talking about canceled flights.

content.text: Usually it's due to bad weather, and usually you can catch another flight soon, but sometimes

content.text: you do have these problems.

content.text: volcano that erupted and European flights were grounded for a long time.

content.text: Yes, that's right.

content.text: So sometimes there are natural disasters.

content.text: there, and something that I think people who are learning about this should definitely

content.text: study.

content.text: The word is grounded.

content.text: A flight has been grounded.

content.text: Yes, that means that the airplane will stay on the ground.

content.text: It means the plane will not fly.

content.text: Okay, so when planes are grounded because of bad weather or because of a natural disaster

content.text: like a volcano, it's a very serious situation because the people who are going to fly can't

content.text: know.

content.trans: 英语：航空公司处理得很好，但我认为这是非常罕见的情况。

content.text: How do you've had flights canceled before?
content.trans: 英语：你以前有没有因为航班取消而经历过飞行延误？

content.text: How did they handle it?
content.trans: 英语：他们怎么处理的？

content.text: I have.
content.trans: 我。

content.text: I've had two or three flights canceled one time because of a blizzard, so all flights
content.trans: 我有两次或三次因为暴风雪取消了航班，所以所有的航班都取消了。

content.text: were grounded.

content.text: there are no more flights, but if you come back tomorrow, we can help you.

content.text: me up at her house.

content.text: company, another airline company.

content.trans: 而且有时候，他们可以做到这一点，即与另一家航空公司有关系。

content.text: company, they can do that.

content.text: It's not their fault.
